stories.title: Woman killed after crash with garbage truck in Fresno County, CHP says
stories.summary: A woman has died after she was hit by a garbage truck in Fresno County on late Monday afternoon.

stories.title: Fresno County launches holiday traffic safety campaign as tougher DUI law nears
stories.summary: Fresno County leaders and law enforcement launched their holiday traffic safety campaign Monday, promising zero tolerance for drunk, distracted and speeding drivers.

stories.title: Fresno County child welfare agency 'failed' key safety standards, state review finds
stories.summary: Fresno County leaders unveiled what they described as "extremely troubling" findings from an independent investigation into the county's child welfare services agency, citing widespread deficiencies in how the department handles child abuse referrals and foster care cases.

stories.title: Dolores Huerta honored with public memorial service in California
stories.summary: Hundreds of people escorted the casket of late labor leader and civil rights icon Dolores Huerta up the steps of the California State Capitol on Monday, paying tribute to her life and decades of advocacy.

stories.title: Tulare County officials prepare for rain, mountain snow impacts
stories.summary: Tulare County officials are preparing for a new round of storms expected this week, urging residents to take precautions as rain moves through the area and conditions develop at higher elevations.

stories.title: AccuWeather Forecast
stories.summary: Watch the latest AccuWeather forecast on ABC30 Action News.

stories.title: Bodycam footage released of Naindeep Singh's October encounter with Fresno police
stories.summary: The Fresno Police Department has released body-camera footage from the night of Naindeep Singh's DUI stop on Oct. 24 in Fresno's Tower District.

stories.title: Madera South graduate wins national FFA award for rabbit breeding business
stories.summary: A recent Madera South High School graduate is bringing national recognition back to the Central Valley after earning a top honor at the National FFA Convention & Expo.

stories.title: Cornell will review future of Greek life on campus following gang-rape allegation
stories.summary: The president of Cornell University says the school will review the future of Greek life on campus after a former student alleged she was gang raped at a frat house.

stories.title: 3 men accused of deadly 2019 Fresno mass shooting will go to trial, judge rules
stories.summary: A judge has ruled that the three men accused of one of the deadliest mass shootings in Fresno back in 2019 will go to trial.

stories.title: United Airlines briefly has 'systemwide' disruption to departing flights
stories.summary: United said there is no indication that this was a cybersecurity-related issue.

stories.title: Man arrested after allegedly sending peanut butter-covered mail to woman with severe allergy
stories.summary: A Florida man was charged with aggravated battery and culpable negligence after sending peanut butter-covered mail to a victim with an allergy.
